page.layout: One page of text, a single column; no margin notes; a catchword-like word "tauio" at lower right of the column is part of the last line's hyphenated continuation.

main_text.p: collo, defpumant ore, qua- tiunt pedibus terram,fentiunt ipfi ornatum fuum, & fuper- biunt. Quotus vero Aulæ tuæ prorfus Regiæ ordo eft? alter Nobilium, qui ad vrba- na eruditi officia hærent: Mi- niftrorum alter, qui fecundis muneribus devouentur: po- ftremus aurigantium, & pe- diffequorum, qui minùs di- gna exequentes, famulatum complent. Hos autem om- nes, & ferico, & purpura, & auro veftis, vt vel in eo tua- niteat munificentia, quòd ij etiam pretiosè teguntur, à quibus pretia contemni de- bent. Sed quantum decoris auget circumfusa Equitum phalanx, quæ Venetijs Pa- tauio

page.notes: The last line is partly obscured by an overprinted stamp and show-through; "Pa-" and "tauio" are read with doubt. Printed text is in a mix of roman and bold, with some words in bold type (e.g. "phalanx", "Pa-") and italic "Equitum". Bottom right faint marks and a digitiser's mark are omitted.
